prompts.name: Turtle
prompts.prompt: Create a square profile avatar for Cuentiva's fantasy bookstore: a cheerful anthropomorphic sea turtle storyteller with teal shell, coral embroidered waistcoat, holding a small worn book, curious expressive eyes. Charming hand-painted gouache children's book illustration with soft watercolor edges, warm cream paper background, sage and terracotta palette. Head and upper body centered inside central 75 percent for circle cropping. No text, watermark or border.
